dashboard.label: First Seen Tracking
dashboard.description: Entities appearing for the first time, tracked by hourly scheduled searches into per-entity KV store collections. Time picker filters by stored first_seen.

html.p: How this dashboard works: entities are tracked by hourly scheduled searches (Beelzebub - Tracker - * in savedsearches) and stored in beelzebub_first_seen_* KV store collections. The dashboard is empty until the first tracker run completes (within ~1 hour of install). Once populated, panels show entities whose first-ever sighting falls inside the selected time window. Click any row to search raw events.

search.query: | inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_source | eval _earliest = coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$"), 0) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"), now())) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | stats count

| inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_credential | eval _earliest = coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$"), 0) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"), now())) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | stats count

| inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_command | eval _earliest = coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$"), 0) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"), now())) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | stats count

| inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_uri | eval _earliest = coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$"), 0) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"), now())) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | stats count

| inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_source | eval _earliest = coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$"), 0) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"), now())) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | eval first_seen = strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval client = if(client="", "(none)", client) | table src_ip, client, first_seen, protocols | sort -first_seen

| inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_credential | eval _earliest = coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$"), 0) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"), now())) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | eval first_seen = strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table username, password, first_seen | sort -first_seen

| inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_uri | eval _earliest = coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$"), 0) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"), now())) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | eval first_seen = strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename http_method AS method, uri_path AS uri | table method, uri, first_seen | sort -first_seen

| inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_user_agent | eval _earliest = coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$"), 0) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"), now())) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | eval first_seen = strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename http_user_agent AS user_agent | table user_agent, first_seen | sort -first_seen

| inputlookup beelzebub_first_seen_command | eval _earliest = coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.earliest$"), 0) | eval _latest = if("$time_range.latest$"="now", now(), coalesce(relative_time(now(), "$time_range.latest$"), now())) | where first_seen >= _earliest AND first_seen <= _latest | fields - _earliest _latest | eval first_seen = strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table command, first_seen | sort -first_seen
